# Bobo Learns

> Bobo Learns is a personal sandbox for learning things, made by Babar Ali and open to everyone because it's fun. Each site is its own small experiment, free to use, and a single optional login works across them.

## Live apps

- [Woofabulary](https://woof.bobolearns.com): free language learning with Mister Bobo: Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese and Urdu.
- [Bobo Learns Chess](https://chess.bobolearns.com): a chess opponent and coach, playing Stockfish in the browser.
- [Ridgeline](https://hike.bobolearns.com): trail maps that work offline, an installable web app with no accounts.
